EmailTemplate.name: Unofficial Test Scores (all populations)
EmailTemplate.subject: We received your unofficial test scores
EmailTemplate.textOnly:
Hello {!Contact.FirstName},
Thank you for sending your test scores to Arizona State University. Admission Services only accepts official SAT and ACT test scores. Official test scores are sent directly to ASU from the College Board/SAT or the ACT corporation.
If you have further questions, please contact your dedicated admission representative at https://asu.edu/findmyrep.
Thank you, Admission Services
If you would like any additional information or have questions related to this subject, please reply to this email.
